tickets.title: Styling a Basic Card
tickets.description: Builds a simple card with padding, rounded corners, a subtle shadow, and slate/blue colors.
tasks: Builds a simple card with padding, rounded corners, a subtle shadow, and slate/blue colors.
learning_objectives: Build pixel-perfect UI without custom CSS.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("rounded-lg")` `check_class_used("shadow-md")` `check_class_used("p-6")` `check_no_inline_styles()` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts if exact padding, border-radius, and font sizes match. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for strictly using Tailwind utility classes. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for avoiding the `style` attribute entirely.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles or a custom stylesheet instead of composing utility classes.
hints: Tailwind's grid system uses 'grid' and 'grid-cols-*' utilities.
Use 'gap-*' to add spacing between grid items.

tickets.title: Responsive Flexbox Navigation
tickets.description: Creates a navigation bar that stacks links vertically on mobile, but uses flexbox to align them horizontally on medium (`md:`) screens and above.
tasks: Creates a navigation bar that stacks links vertically on mobile, but uses flexbox to align them horizontally on medium (`md:`) screens and above.
learning_objectives: Understand Flexbox layout with Tailwind utilities.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("flex-col")` `check_class_used("md:flex-row")` `check_class_used("md:space-x-4")` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts if navigation links flow horizontally above 768px. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for correctly utilizing responsive prefix `md:`. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for using `space-x/y` utilities instead of individual margins on items.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles or a custom stylesheet instead of composing utility classes.
hints: Use 'flex', 'justify-center', and 'items-center' to quickly center content.
